correctness.rationale: Direct flux balance proves stationarity. A fully demonstrated log-convex reciprocal-series argument proves monotonicity of renewal mass and hence the zero-start exact TV tail. The delayed renewal convolution has a uniform O(i^-1) hazard bound; the explicit finite criterion forces strict deficit at every state except the no-reset high atom. This proves an exact signed Hahn decomposition, integer mixing threshold, and the unique positive optimizer (with complement for negative discrepancy). Union bounds for iT renewed excursions and the exact telescoping first-reset survival prove the J1 one-shot limit. 10523 finite rational/high-precision checks supplement the analytic proof.

value.rationale: High-state initial conditions are natural in the catastrophe population and reliability model; they cause metastable persistence invisible in fixed-start stationary results. The theorem supplies an exact finite-window optimal hypothesis-test event, exact eventual integer mixing time with O(1) additive error for every beta>1 (including infinite-variance return regimes), and a process-level mechanism showing a single Pareto-timed collapse. This is substantively more than a known zeta law, zero-start renewal rate, arbitrary parameter substitution or finite computation.
